# Psalm 79 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 79:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** They-have-given the-corpse-of your-servants food for-birds-of the-heavens, the-flesh-of your-faithful-ones for-beasts-of the-earth.
- **LOGOS:** They have given the bodies of your servants to the birds of the heavens for food, the flesh of your faithful to the beasts of the earth.
- **PNEUMA:** They left the bodies of your servants out for the vultures and threw your faithful people to the wild animals.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 79:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** How-long O-YHWH? Will-you-be-angry to-perpetuity? Will-burn like-fire your-jealousy?
- **LOGOS:** How long, O LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
- **PNEUMA:** How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? How long will your fury burn like a wildfire?

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 79:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Do-not remember against-us iniquities-of the-former-ones; quickly let-go-before-us your-compassions, for we-are-brought-very-low.
- **LOGOS:** Do not remember against us our former iniquities; let your compassion come speedily to meet us, for we are brought very low.
- **PNEUMA:** Don't hold the sins of past generations against us. Rush to meet us with your mercy, because we are absolutely desperate.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 79:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Help-us O-God-of our-salvation, on-account-of glory-of your-name; and-deliver-us and-atone for-our-sins, for-sake-of your-name.
- **LOGOS:** Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of your name; deliver us, and atone for our sins, for your name's sake!
- **PNEUMA:** Help us, God our savior! For the honor of your name, rescue us! Wipe away our sins — do it for your reputation!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 79:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Let-come before-you the-groaning-of the-prisoner; according-to-greatness-of your-arm preserve the-children-of death.
- **LOGOS:** Let the groans of the prisoners come before you; according to your great power, preserve those doomed to die!
- **PNEUMA:** Let the cries of the prisoners reach your ears. With your enormous power, save those who are condemned to die!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** And-return to-our-neighbors sevenfold into-their-bosom their-reproach with-which they-have-reproached-you O-Lord.
